title: 第3章 朱雀灵火第4章 还有这好事
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 火焰瞬间席卷整个房间，朱雀殿炸炉的响动也震动整个药王宫，一时间无数弟子从四面八方赶来。
“快灭火！”
有人指挥开始灭火，可是火焰却太凶猛了，不光将炸炉的房间烧毁，更是把旁边的两个房间一起点燃。
看到这一幕冯飞脸都绿了，一场灵火测试，怎么搞成这样？
楚星河表面上看起来好像吓傻了，可内心都要唱起好日子了。
烧吧……把整个朱雀殿全都烧了才好，大长老要是一怒之下能直接把自己逐出师门那就太完美了。
不过楚星河的想法很快就破灭了，因为朱雀殿炸炉失火的消息传到了大长老那边，大长老第一时间带着人前来，在大长老以及其他几位长老的联手之下，火焰终究还是被熄灭了下去。
虽然没能烧掉整个朱雀殿，但看着灰头土脸的大长老以及其他人，楚星河知道，自己成功了。
“到底是谁！”
大长老的声音震动整个朱雀殿，无论弟子还是长老一瞬间都是无人敢言语。
冯飞用一种看死人的表情看着楚星河，他知道，楚星河这一次估计是彻底完犊子了。
“冯飞！
到底怎么回事！”
大长老将目光看向冯飞。
冯飞连忙从地上爬起来道：“大长老，这是个意外，今日……”
冯飞不敢隐瞒，将楚星河测试灵火的事情说了出来，但话语结束，冯飞再次开口：“还请大长老息怒，今日之事虽然是星河师弟，但我身为监管师兄没有能够阻止，也应该承受责任，还请大长老不要全怪星河师弟！”
好人啊！
楚星河看着身边的冯飞都有点后悔了，自己这等于是变相的坑了冯飞，可是冯飞却要站出来替自己承担，这位冯师兄让楚星河心中满是感激。
“是你？”
可大长老根本没有理会冯飞，而是直接一个闪身来到了楚星河身边。
大长老并不是冯飞师兄说的那样，冯飞师兄已经将所有注意事项全部都跟我说明，是我自己没有用心去听，才导致如此结果，千错万错全是我一人，还请大长老不要处罚冯飞师兄！”
听完楚星河的话，冯飞也是一惊，他没想到楚星河竟然会一人揽下所有，之前楚星河站出来为同乡顶罪的事情传的沸沸扬扬，但后来听说楚星河的那位同乡被人打断了手臂，有传闻说楚星河跟同乡其实根本不和，就是装出来的。
但现在冯飞只想给那些背后说这种话的人一个大耳刮子！
看看吧！
星河师弟在这种情况下也没有进行任何甩锅，而是怕自己会被处罚而独自扛下一切，这样的星河师弟怎么可能是他们背后传闻的那样！
可就在冯飞无比感动的都快落泪之时，大长老却突然开口了：“真的是你？”
“千真万确！
星河有愧于大长老提携，自知罪孽深重，请大长老从重处罚！”
楚星河脸上满是愧疚，但心里却乐开了花！
逐出师门！
快把我逐出师门啊，真不行把我精英弟子的身份取消掉也行啊。
巅峰武帝修为拿不到，拿个三品大武师也行啊，直接从一品武者晋升三品大武师，想想就舒服啊。
但楚星河没有等来大长老的责罚，却直接被大长老拉着进入了另一个灵火测试的房间之中，指着地火开口：“来！
你再把刚才的事情重复一遍！”
content_en:
Flames instantly swept through the entire room, and the sound of the Suzaku Palace furnace explosion also shook the entire Yaowang Palace. Countless disciples rushed from all directions.
"Quickly put out the fire!"
Someone directed the fire to be put out, but the flames were too fierce. Not only did the room where the explosion furnace burned down, but it also ignited the two rooms next to it.
Feng Fei's face turned green when he saw this scene. How could a spiritual fire test end up like this?
On the surface Chu Xinghe looked like he was frightened, but in his heart he was singing about good times.
Burn it... Burn the entire Suzaku Hall. It would be perfect if the Great Elder could directly expel himself from the master in a fit of rage.
However, Chu Xinghe's idea was soon shattered, because the news of the fire in the Suzaku Palace furnace reached the Great Elder. The Great Elder immediately came with his people. With the joint efforts of the Great Elder and several other elders, the flames were finally extinguished.
Although he failed to burn down the entire Suzaku Palace, looking at the disgraced First Elder and others, Chu Xinghe knew that he had succeeded.
"Who is it?"
The great elder's voice shook the entire Suzaku Hall. No one dared to speak, no matter the disciples or the elders.
Feng Fei looked at Chu Xinghe with a dead look. He knew that Chu Xinghe was probably completely screwed this time.
"Feng Fei!
What's going on! "
The great elder looked at Feng Fei.
Feng Fei quickly got up from the ground and said, "Great Elder, this was an accident. Today..."
Feng Fei did not dare to hide it and told him about Chu Xinghe's test of the spiritual fire. But after the words were finished, Feng Fei spoke again: "Great Elder, please calm down. Although Junior Brother Xinghe is responsible for what happened today, I, as the Supervisory Brother, failed to stop it and should bear the responsibility. Please don't blame Junior Brother Xinghe entirely!"
What a good man!
Chu Xinghe felt a little regretful when he looked at Feng Fei next to him. He had tricked Feng Fei in disguise, but Feng Fei had to stand up and take the responsibility for him. This senior brother Feng made Chu Xinghe feel full of gratitude.
"Is it you?"
But the Great Elder ignored Feng Fei at all, and instead ducked directly to Chu Xinghe.
"Yes!
The Great Elder is not what Senior Brother Feng Fei said. Senior Brother Feng Fei has explained all the precautions to me. It was me who did not listen attentively, which led to this result. I am the only one who made all the mistakes. Please do not punish Senior Brother Feng Fei! "
After hearing what Chu Xinghe said, Feng Fei was also shocked. He didn't expect that Chu Xinghe would take over everything by himself. Previously, there were a lot of rumors about Chu Xinghe standing up to take the blame for his fellow villagers. But then he heard that Chu Xinghe's fellow villager had his arm broken. There were rumors that Chu Xinghe and his fellow villagers were not at odds with each other at all, and they were just pretending.
But now Feng Fei just wants to give those who say such things behind their backs a slap in the face!
Check it out!
In this situation, Junior Brother Xinghe did not make any attempt to shirk the blame, but was afraid that he would be punished and shouldered everything alone. How could such Junior Brother Xinghe be what they rumored behind his back!
But just when Feng Fei was so moved that he almost shed tears, the great elder suddenly spoke: "Is it really you?"
"Absolutely true!
Xinghe is unworthy of the support of the Great Elder. He knows that he has committed a serious crime and asks the Great Elder to punish him severely! "
Chu Xinghe's face was full of guilt, but his heart was filled with joy!
Expelled from the division!
Quickly expel me from the master's sect. If it really doesn't work, just cancel my status as an elite disciple.
If you can't get the peak Martial Emperor cultivation level, you can get a third-grade great martial artist. It's comfortable to be directly promoted from a first-grade warrior to a third-grade great martial artist.
But Chu Xinghe did not wait for the Great Elder's punishment, but was directly pulled by the Great Elder into another room where the spiritual fire was tested, pointed at the ground fire and said: "Come!
Just repeat what you just said! "
"Huh?"
